exposure: Intrauterine growth restriction (IUGR) induced by uteroplacental vessel ligation
outcome: DAB staining of MEL receptors in the brain
cohort: The study participants were pregnant rabbits, with IUGR induced in one uterine horn and the other serving as control.
finding: Melatonin (MEL) demonstrated beneficial effects on the IUGR brain by increasing oligodendrocyte numbers, but showed detrimental effects in control groups, suggesting its actions are context-dependent.
birth_weight: N/A (body weights were measured as an outcome, but no specific inclusion range was mentioned)
